episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.overview: Struggling to keep her marriage alive, Funda is overcome with the stresses of first-time motherhood, until the perfect caretaker walks into her life.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.overview: Funda's hunger to get back in her art studio is enough to overlook the details of İlker's confession… But is there more to his story?

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.overview: While Funda makes an effort to get to know Nazlı a bit better, İlker tries to keep his distance but can't help keeping a watchful eye on her.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.overview: Funda can't wait to leave town for work when her in-laws drop in for a visit, but İlker escapes the crossfire by getting lost in old memories.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.overview: Returning to her studio, Funda gets the sense that something is off. Ridden with guilt and fear, Nazlı attempts to sidestep her suspicions.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.overview: With Emre's life on the line, Nazlı is consumed by memories of her own accident. İlker worries that Emre will wake up and divulge his secret.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.overview: As her exhibition prepares to launch, Funda is unable to shake the events leading up to Emre's fate and all she has come to know about her husband.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.overview: As everything she's built goes up in flames, Funda seeks help, realizing that her mental state has become a danger to her life and her family.
